name: Two Ends of a Scarf
prompt: Suspend a wide red woven roadway between thick wooden knitting needles planted as towers. A crew on the unfinished span loops the next cable with a wheeled hook. Loose strands spill into orderly wicker baskets on the ground.

name: The Bridge Takes a Breath
prompt: Shape the deck as a shallow accordion of cream bellows. Slender black chains hang from two leaning masts. As one section expands to admit a street market, neighbouring sections contract and vendors fold their awnings.

name: The Upside-Down Orchard
prompt: Hang rows of pear trees in baskets beneath an elevated lavender footbridge. Fruit pickers use a second, lower set of suspended planks. Leave a clear gap through the foliage where a basket is being hoisted onto the deck.

name: The Missing Middle
prompt: Face two broad masonry platforms across an open courtyard. Their only connection is a procession of separate brass stepping discs hung from a slack cable. A keeper shifts a single disc to make room for a wedding party.

name: A Bridge of Borrowed Doors
prompt: Hang a patchwork of differently painted household doors from a pair of sweeping cables. Neighbours fit fresh doors into the deck with strap hinges. Show brass knobs still attached along one edge, and an inviting queue of handcarts.
